title: Speaking Practice 11 - Daily Routine
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Questions about daily routines and time management.

stimuli.title: Part 1: Daily Routine
stimuli.content: Answer questions about your typical day and routines.

questionGroups.instruction: Answer the following questions about your daily routine.

questions.content: What does a typical day look like for you?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I usually wake up around 7, have breakfast, then attend university classes until noon. In the afternoon, I study or work on projects.

questions.content: Are you a morning person or a night owl?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I'm definitely a night owl. I feel most productive and creative late at night, which isn't always ideal for early morning classes.

questions.content: What do you usually do in your free time?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I enjoy playing video games, going to cafes with friends, and occasionally hiking on weekends.

questions.content: Do you think routines are important?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, having a routine helps me stay organized and productive. Without one, I tend to procrastinate and waste time.

questions.content: Has your routine changed much since the pandemic?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, significantly. I spent much more time at home and got used to online learning. Even now, I still prefer doing some activities remotely.
